title: 504 — Creating comics together with Kahran and Divya
summary: Kahran and Divya talk about their first sprint making comics together — what it felt like to co-create across writing and illustration, and how making small things in parallel to client work feeds creative energy. They detour into creator vs. entrepreneur mindset, why some founders want to keep their hands on execution instead of scaling away from it, and what that means for how Joyus grows.

intents.display: to hear two collaborators figure out how to make comics together
to think about staying a maker instead of scaling like an entrepreneur
